documents.title: Documents
documents.count: {count, plural, =0 {No files yet} one {# file} other {# files}}
documents.empty: No documents yet. Photos added to tasks and files uploaded here appear in this list.

evidence.title: Photos and files
evidence.hint: Photos upload as soon as you pick them. JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or PDF, up to 25 MB each.
evidence.files: {count, plural, one {# file attached} other {# files attached}}

company.title: Logo, signature and stamp
company.description: Printed on every quotation and statutory report.
company.hint: PNG with a transparent background looks best. Until you upload one, documents use the images that came with OneOhm.

intro.project: Site photos, papers, quotations and reports for the whole project, in one place.
intro.customer: Every file for this customer, across their sites and projects, in one place.
intro.lead: Papers collected for this lead, such as the electricity bill and ID proof. They stay with the customer when the lead becomes a project.
intro.contractor: This contractor's agreement, licence, insurance and ID papers, with the work orders we issued them.
intro.vendor: This vendor's papers: agreements, test certificates and other submissions.

gallery.searchLabel: Search documents by title or file name
gallery.shown: {count, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} shown.

empty.title: No documents yet
empty.description: Keep site photos, KYC papers, bills, quotations and reports here, so the office and the crew work from the same files.
empty.readOnly: Photos added to tasks and files uploaded by the office appear here.

noMatch.description: Try another folder or kind of file, or clear the search.

preview.replacedNote: This file replaced an earlier one. The earlier file is kept in the audit trail.
preview.noInline: This file cannot be shown here. Open it full size or download it.

confirm.body: Removing takes the document out of this list and it can no longer be opened here. The record of who added and removed it stays in the audit trail.

upload.description: One photo or PDF, filed in a folder so the team can find it.
upload.choose: Choose a file or drop it here
upload.accepted: Photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC) or PDF, up to 25 MB
upload.title: Title
upload.titleHint: How the team will find it. Taken from the file name if left empty.

errors.type: This kind of file cannot be added. Choose a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC) or a PDF.
errors.size: This file is {size}. The limit is 25 MB.

select.count: {count, plural, =0 {Pick documents} one {# document picked} other {# documents picked}}

move.title: Move / change kind
move.description: File this paper on another home of this customer, or as another kind. Nothing is sent to the customer, unless a request it answered is now asked again.
move.needsHome: Choose the home this paper belongs to.
move.loadFailed: Could not load the customer's homes

checklist.title: Document checklist
checklist.saved: {saved, plural, =0 {No report changed} one {# report saved} other {# reports saved}}{unchanged, plural, =0 {} other {; # already up to date}}.

requests.title: Asked from the customer
requests.intro: Everything we asked the customer to do: papers, locations, payments and calls. Use Send to customer at the top to ask for more.

sheet.title: Ask the customer for a paper
sheet.description: The customer gets a WhatsApp message and an alert in the OneOhm app, and sends a photo or PDF from there.
sheet.whatHint: The customer sees exactly this, for example "Latest electricity bill".
sheet.notePlaceholder: For example: the bill must show the consumer number.
sheet.sent: {count, plural, one {Request sent to the customer} other {# requests sent to the customer}}

reask.title: Ask again for this paper
reask.description: The paper is taken off and the customer is asked again. They see your reason in the OneOhm app and on WhatsApp.
reask.note: What is wrong with it? The customer sees this.
reask.notePlaceholder: For example: the photo is blurred; please send a clear one.
reask.descriptionTeam: The paper our team filed stays on file. The customer will be asked to send it again, and sees your reason in the OneOhm app and on WhatsApp.

requests.reminders: {count, plural, one {# reminder sent} other {# reminders sent}}
requests.checked: Paper checked. The customer is told.
requests.checkFailed: Could not mark the paper as checked

location.suggestion: The customer sent a pin {distance} from the saved point.
location.suggestionNew: The customer sent a pin; the home has no saved point.

reportVisibility.title: Statutory reports
reportVisibility.description: Which reports customers see in their app, and which are saved to the project documents by themselves when their task is done, and again if their details change before they are submitted. The team always sees every report.
reportVisibility.noTrigger: No task makes it; save it from the project's document checklist.
reportVisibility.autoOff: {name} is now saved only by hand
reportVisibility.failed: Could not change the report setting
